publisher: U.S. Department of the Treasury, Bureau of the Fiscal Service

datasets.title: Debt to the Penny
datasets.description: Daily outstanding federal debt, debt held by the public and intragovernmental holdings. Original Treasury monetary fields are preserved as published.

datasets.title: Average Interest Rates on U.S. Treasury Securities
datasets.description: Original Treasury monthly average-interest-rate records by security classification; percentages remain publisher records.

datasets.title: Daily Treasury Operating Cash Balance
datasets.description: Daily Treasury Statement operating cash account balances; values are published in millions of dollars.

datasets.title: Daily Debt Subject to Statutory Limit
datasets.description: Original Daily Treasury Statement records on federal debt subject to limit; avoid interpreting them as Treasury debt-to-the-penny totals.

datasets.title: Daily Federal Tax Deposits
datasets.description: Federal tax deposits reported in the Daily Treasury Statement; raw published classifications and units retained.

datasets.title: Daily Income Tax Refunds Issued
datasets.description: Refund amounts and counts as reported in the Daily Treasury Statement, retaining publisher categorizations.

datasets.title: Monthly Federal Receipts, Outlays and Deficit/Surplus
datasets.description: Monthly Treasury Statement summary receipts, outlays and budget surplus or deficit, preserving the original published classification and reporting period.

datasets.title: Monthly Federal Budget and Financing Results
datasets.description: Monthly Treasury Statement budget and off-budget receipts, outlays and financing entries, retained in publisher hierarchy.

datasets.title: Monthly Federal Receipts and Outlays
datasets.description: Original Monthly Treasury Statement receipts and outlays totals and source classifications; no ARFI-derived aggregates.

datasets.title: Federal Receipts by Source
datasets.description: Treasury monthly receipts by category, retaining original department and classification rows rather than recomputing totals.

datasets.title: Federal Outlays by Function
datasets.description: Treasury monthly outlays by function and source classification, with original subtotals kept distinct.
